title: Talk about experiences
description: Practise Have you ever...? and talk about travel experiences.

items.targetText: I have never tried skydiving, but I have already visited London.
items.hint: never and already with Present Perfect

items.prompt: Talk about one travel experience in two or three sentences.
items.promptIt: Parla di un'esperienza di viaggio in due o tre frasi.
items.exampleAnswer: I have travelled abroad twice. Last year we missed a connecting flight, but we explored the old town on foot.
items.hint: Mix Present Perfect and Past Simple
